_comment: Hand-authored RAM map. One entry per named byte or range; every entry says how it is known. status: 'confirmed' = read from the code that uses it (evidence names the routine); 'checked' = also checked against a savestate or a run; 'lead' = a reading of the code or of one use, not established. The generated cross-reference (tools/tgl/ram.py) is shown beside each entry and is not claimed here.

ranges.name: Zero page
ranges.what: Scratch, pointers, game state, the pads, the scroll engine's counters.

ranges.name: PPU queue, stack and small buffers
ranges.what: The PPU write queue grows up from $0100; the CPU stack grows down from $01FF. The score, the palette shadow and the status screen's buffers sit in the middle.

ranges.name: OAM shadow
ranges.what: Sprite memory, DMA'd to the PPU every frame (bank 7 NMI).

ranges.name: Sound state
ranges.what: The sound engine of bank 0: flags, a busy mask, the APU register shadow and seven soft channels.

ranges.name: Stage and progress state
ranges.what: Corridor overlay slots, the loaded metatile sets, per-area flags, weapon levels, keys, the row of metatiles being built, and the labyrinth move history.

ranges.name: Object slots
ranges.what: 24 slots x 32 fields: field f of slot s is at $0500 + $18 f + s. See the field table.

entries.name: live_bank
entries.what: The PRG bank currently selected. Every bank-switch routine writes it.

entries.name: dmc_rate
entries.what: The DMC timer's rate index, reloaded into $4010 by the IRQ and tuned between $81 and $89 to land the raster split.

entries.name: scratch
entries.what: Scratch. The far-call trampoline saves A and Y here.

entries.name: farcall_ptr
entries.what: The far-call trampoline's pointer to its three inline bytes (bank, target low, target high).

entries.name: args
entries.what: Arguments and scratch. For the $D5CC queue-a-fill helper, $15 is the count byte (bit 7: step 32) and $14 the fill value. For a spawn, $15 is the type.

entries.name: src_ptr
entries.what: A source pointer: the screen-script renderer's script, the inline-string helpers' return address, a structure's tiles.

entries.name: ppu_addr
entries.what: A PPU address (low, high) for the queue producers; also reused as an object's x/y or an index in some handlers.

entries.name: ptr2
entries.what: A second pointer or PPU address pair: the status screen's map walk builds the map address into it, and the rectangle blit's loop positions use it.

entries.name: queue_len
entries.what: The PPU queue's fill state: $21 is the byte offset of the next entry, $20 counts flushes.

entries.name: ppustatus_snapshot
entries.what: PPUSTATUS read once per NMI.

entries.name: frame_counter
entries.what: Counts NMIs. The wait-frames routine $FFD1 clears it and the wait loops $DA9A/$DAD8 spin on it.
entries.evidence: bank 7 $DA9A-$DAE0, $FFD1; the NES model's frame loop depends on it

entries.name: boot_flag
entries.what: Branched on in the boot path; set to 0 by a new game and by the TGL back door.

entries.name: game_mode
entries.what: Mode bits - see the table below.
entries.evidence: many; the bits are listed with their writers

entries.name: weapon_value
entries.what: A per-weapon value from bank 6 $FDCA; compared in the damage routine. Meaning not established.

entries.name: weapon
entries.what: The selected weapon: 0 none, 1-12.

entries.name: weapon_level
entries.what: The selected weapon's level, 0-3.

entries.name: uses_left
entries.what: Chips / $45, or $04AF for weapon 12.

entries.name: score_dirty
entries.what: Set when the score changes; the HUD routine redraws the score once and clears it.

entries.name: frame_tick
entries.what: Incremented once per game frame by the main loops; handlers mask it for periodic actions (a shot every 16 or 32 frames).

entries.name: chips_per_use
entries.what: Chips spent per shot of the selected weapon.

entries.name: chip_level
entries.what: Set to 6 by the demo setup and read by the status screen. Meaning not established.

entries.name: life_max
entries.what: Maximum life. The score bonus and the Energy Tank add 8, capped at $FF; the demo starts at $80.

entries.name: life
entries.what: Current life; the score bonus sets it to $47.

entries.name: attack_shield
entries.what: Attack and shield levels (1-4); $FD4B gives the player's attack from $4A.

entries.name: chips
entries.what: Chips held (16-bit, the dividend in $FD77). The score bonus refills them from $4E/$4F.

entries.name: chip_max
entries.what: The number printed after CHIP MAX.

entries.name: area
entries.what: The labyrinth area, 0-10, which the HUD prints after AREA. Leaving corridor n sets it to n folded onto 1-10.

entries.name: corridor
entries.what: The corridor, 0-22; also the screen type of a labyrinth special screen ($EE1D) and the stream-table index. 22 is the final corridor.

entries.name: map_col_row
entries.what: The player's map column and row in the labyrinth, stepped by $8071 and shown as X/Y in the HUD.

entries.name: item_icon
entries.what: The item a labyrinth item room holds: $A377[sub-id], an icon number.

entries.name: spawn_script
entries.what: The spawn script id of the current room (1-47).

entries.name: door_keys
entries.what: The key each exit's door needs, N W E S (the neighbour's byte 1 AND 7).

entries.name: scene
entries.what: The scene number loaded next (tiles, metatile sets, palettes).

entries.name: room_kind
entries.what: A labyrinth room's kind: $00 plain, $20 item, $40 miniboss, $60 loop gate.

entries.name: room_sub
entries.what: A room's sub-id; the flag index for items and minibosses.

entries.name: flags_60
entries.what: Bit flags; the stage-clear routine clears bits 0-1. Meaning not established.

entries.name: spawn_ptr
entries.what: The running spawn script's pointer ($7F is its bank).

entries.name: toggle
entries.what: Bit 0 flips every call of bank 6 $AD9A; the bosses use it for alternating shots. Not random.

entries.name: lives_or_life
entries.what: Set to 2 by the demo and by the password decoder with the max life; the HUD shows a heart and a count. Which of those it is was not settled.

entries.name: boss_phase
entries.what: The boss phase: 0 none; 1 set up; 2 wait for the scroll; 3 spawn; 4 fight; 6 the explosion count; back to 0.
entries.evidence: bank 3 $917F-$93EE; observed 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 6 -> 0 in the corridor 0 run

entries.name: corridor_boss_flags
entries.what: $913A[corridor]: bit 7 = turn live enemies into explosions when the boss phase starts, bit 3 copied into $60.

entries.name: boss_type
entries.what: The boss object type to spawn: $9151[corridor], or command 5's operand in corridor 21.

entries.name: boss_timer
entries.what: The boss routine's frame counter (lo, hi); 90 frames after the explosions.

entries.name: boss_slot
entries.what: The object slot a boss was spawned into.

entries.name: tgl_index
entries.what: Index into $ED08, the TGL game's corridor order.

entries.name: life_at_start
entries.what: $47 as the corridor began (read back by the continue path).

entries.name: saved_pos
entries.what: The map position the progress recorder keeps ($52/$53).

entries.name: script_bank
entries.what: The bank the running spawn script lives in (5 for rooms, 4 for corridor waves).

entries.name: draw_regs
entries.what: What the metasprite drawer reads: $84 y, $85 x, $86 attributes, $87 base tile. $CC34 draws a record at these.
entries.evidence: bank 7 $CBFC-$CE23; the Fleepa and Grimgrin OAM matches

entries.name: ms_ptr
entries.what: The metasprite record being drawn.

entries.name: stage_flags
entries.what: Stage event bits - see the table below.

entries.name: row_phase
entries.what: Which row of the current row table the next background row is: the table's rows repeat, cycling this.

entries.name: exit_dir
entries.what: Which way the player left a labyrinth room: 0 north, 2 west, 6 east, 8 south (4 = none).

entries.name: scroll_fx
entries.what: Scroll helpers: $AC/$AD give a ground object the scroll's y velocity (lo, hi) at spawn, $AE its x velocity; $AA a column base for it.

entries.name: row_pixels
entries.what: Pixels scrolled within the current 16-pixel background row.

entries.name: row_counter
entries.what: The stage clock: background rows since the corridor began. Stream records fire when it equals their trigger.

entries.name: scroll_acc
entries.what: The scroll position accumulator (fraction, whole) the speed is subtracted from.

entries.name: scroll_speed
entries.what: The scroll speed in 1/256 pixel a frame, ramped 2/256 a frame toward $BA/$BB.

entries.name: scroll_target
entries.what: The speed command 0 sets the scroll toward (bit 7 of the high byte: at once).

entries.name: stream_ptr
entries.what: The pointer into the corridor's event stream (bank 4).

entries.name: room_north_west
entries.what: The map records of the north ($E0) and west ($E2) neighbours of the current room.

entries.name: room_ptr
entries.what: The current room's map record.

entries.name: room_east_south
entries.what: The east ($E6) and south ($E8) neighbours' records.

entries.name: demo_timer
entries.what: The demo's timer; it also counts the credits screens.

entries.name: pads_new
entries.what: Buttons newly pressed, pads 1 and 2 (A = $80 ... Right = $01).

entries.name: pads_held
entries.what: Buttons held. A and B held at reset ($F7 = $C0) starts the sound test.

entries.name: ppumask_shadow
entries.what: The PPUMASK value the game wants.

entries.name: ppuctrl_shadow
entries.what: The PPUCTRL value the game wants; bit 7 is the NMI enable the wait loops test.

entries.name: ppu_queue
entries.what: The PPU write queue, staged here: [count][ppu_hi][ppu_lo][data...]. The count byte's top two bits give the type - under $80 a run with increment 1, $80-$BF increment 32, $C0 and up an attribute read-modify-write. (The stack shares this page and grows down from $01FF.)

entries.name: password_work
entries.what: The password decoder's 24 output bytes, borrowing the PPU queue's staging area.

entries.name: map_row_buffer
entries.what: The status screen's map row buffer: a quadrant mask per tile, flushed every second row.

entries.name: score
entries.what: The score, six decimal digits, one a byte, in tens: a fixed 0 is printed after them. $0170 is the 1,000,000s digit.

entries.name: status_saved
entries.what: The weapon selected, and sprite 0's Y, saved while the status screen is up.

entries.name: bonus_threshold
entries.what: The next score-bonus threshold, three digits, compared with $0170-$0172. $017C = $FF ends the bonuses.
entries.evidence: bank 7 $DF3D; bank 0 $80A5-$80B3; run at chosen scores

entries.name: palette_shadow
entries.what: The palette the game wants: the backdrop, then 8 palettes of 3 colours (4 background, 4 sprite).
entries.evidence: bank 5 $B2E4; two savestates; the cutscene's backdrop flash writes $0180

entries.name: palette_slots
entries.what: Eight palette slot indices the stream's command 8 writes.

entries.name: oam
entries.what: The OAM shadow, copied by DMA every NMI. Sprite 0 is the HUD's raster-split marker; $02F0-$02FF are the status screen's and the credits' own.
entries.evidence: bank 7 NMI; the OAM matches in three savestates

entries.name: sound_flag
entries.what: A sound request / song-done flag: command $94 sets it ($10) after the title song's first pass; the boss routine waits on it.

entries.name: sound_busy
entries.what: The mask of the four hardware channels in use.

entries.name: apu_shadow
entries.what: The APU register shadow, flushed to $4000-$400F; $FF means skip.

entries.name: sound_channels
entries.what: Seven soft channels: field f of channel c at $0319 + 7 f + c.

entries.name: overlay_slots
entries.what: A corridor's eight overlay slots (structures placed over the background): column, repeat count, height, row pointer.

entries.name: password_field
entries.what: The password screen's 32 characters, each a grid index. Shares the page with the overlay slots, which are not in use on that screen.

entries.name: password_payload
entries.what: The decoded password payload; index i is read to $0439 + i.

entries.name: set_ptr_lo
entries.what: The low bytes of the eight loaded metatile set windows.

entries.name: set_ptr_hi
entries.what: The high bytes of the same pointers.

entries.name: set_tile_base
entries.what: Each set's tile base.

entries.name: set_spawn_list
entries.what: Each set's spawn list: 0-2, an index into the three pointers at bank 5 $803C. The corridor spawner uses it.

entries.name: loaded_block
entries.what: The tile block loaded in each art slot.

entries.name: loaded_tile
entries.what: The tile position each art slot loaded to.

entries.name: item_flags
entries.what: One flag per item room and miniboss, set when taken or beaten; the password carries them.

entries.name: areas_cleared
entries.what: One bit per corridor, set when its boss is beaten; hides the entrance marker.

entries.name: weapon_levels
entries.what: Two bits a weapon, weapon 1 in the low bits of $04AC.

entries.name: eraser_count
entries.what: Weapon 12 (the Enemy Eraser)'s stock.

entries.name: keys
entries.what: The keys held, bit k-1 for key k.

entries.name: tgl_total
entries.what: The TGL game's running score total, six digits; / 10,000 gives the reward index $15.

entries.name: corridor_score
entries.what: The score as a corridor began; the boss turns it into the points gained, ticking 10 off every 64 frames.

entries.name: row_cells
entries.what: The 16 cells of the background row being built: metatile ids, then (after drawing) each metatile's fifth byte, which the ground-object spawner reads.
entries.evidence: bank 7 $E8AB; bank 5 $83B3, $89FB; the corridor 0 spawn trace

entries.name: palette_saved
entries.what: The palette, saved while a screen fades or the status screen is up.

entries.name: move_history
entries.what: The last ten moves in the labyrinth, one direction pushed per move; the loop gates sum them.

object_fields.name: type
object_fields.what: The object type; bit 7 is set once its handler has initialised it.

object_fields.name: y
object_fields.what: Y position.
object_fields.evidence: bank 7 $CBFC; the Grimgrin and Fleepa OAM matches

object_fields.name: x
object_fields.what: X position.

object_fields.name: metasprite
object_fields.what: The metasprite id to draw.

object_fields.name: attributes
object_fields.what: Sprite attributes: palette in bits 0-1, bit 6 flips horizontally, bit 7 vertically.

object_fields.name: collision_flags
object_fields.what: Which sides it collides with (from $D02C); bit 7 skips it. The boss runs zero the player's to make it untouchable.

object_fields.name: hp
object_fields.what: Hit points (from $D0AB).

object_fields.name: attack
object_fields.what: Damage it deals on contact (from $D12A).

object_fields.name: yvel_frac
object_fields.what: Y velocity, fractional byte.

object_fields.name: yvel
object_fields.what: Y velocity, signed whole byte.

object_fields.name: xvel_frac
object_fields.what: X velocity, fractional byte.

object_fields.name: xvel
object_fields.what: X velocity, signed whole byte.

object_fields.name: draw_flags
object_fields.what: Drawing flags (from $D1A9), tested bit by bit by the drawer.

object_fields.name: phase
object_fields.what: Animation / phase counter, whole part ($CD7A: add A, wrap at Y).

object_fields.name: phase_frac
object_fields.what: The phase counter's fraction.

object_fields.name: target_y
object_fields.what: The y the object accelerates toward ($CD12), or a direction number the aim routine returned - handlers reuse it.

object_fields.name: target_x
object_fields.what: The x the object accelerates toward ($CD46).

object_fields.name: param
object_fields.what: A spawn parameter handlers pass to the thing they create (a shot's speed class). Meaning varies.

object_fields.name: param2
object_fields.what: A second parameter, set from a per-variant table by the shot handler. Meaning not established.

object_fields.name: base_tile
object_fields.what: The base tile the drawer adds to a metasprite's relative tiles ($87).

object_fields.name: box_x_min
object_fields.what: Hitbox: x minus the metasprite's half width.

object_fields.name: box_x_max
object_fields.what: Hitbox: x plus the half width.

object_fields.name: box_y_min
object_fields.what: Hitbox: y minus the half height.

object_fields.name: box_y_max
object_fields.what: Hitbox: y plus the half height.

object_fields.name: aux_hp
object_fields.what: The high part of the hit points ($D385 shifts the hit points into it) and the type an object had when it died.

object_fields.name: pos_frac
object_fields.what: A position fraction added to the y velocity's fraction by some handlers.

object_fields.name: unknown_26
object_fields.what: Not named.

object_fields.name: timer
object_fields.what: A countdown handlers use first: an entry timer, a shot direction, a spawned shot's aim.

object_fields.name: state
object_fields.what: A state or counter: the boss's state byte, a spawned shot's variant.

object_fields.name: aux3
object_fields.what: Per-handler scratch (a fire delay, a stage index).

object_fields.name: aux4
object_fields.what: Per-handler scratch (an animation length, a mask).

object_fields.name: block_base
object_fields.what: The tile block base the object's art loaded to; $CF8D copies it from $06C8 at spawn, handlers move $06C8 and leave this.

$30.what: Demo (attract mode): set by the demo's setup and tested at $EB9C and by the award code.
A corridor or a special screen is running (set at corridor start by $EF97 = ORA #$50, and by $F2C3 = ORA #$48).
A labyrinth special screen: the room drawer takes its special path.
Tested in the NMI; set at corridor start with bit 6.
Set with bit 6 when a corridor loads; cleared at $F446.
Quiet: no score-bonus jingle ($DF80); set while the score is zeroed at game start.

$A0.what: End of stage: set when a boss is beaten (corridor) or a room exit is taken; the scroll step tests it and jumps to $EB18.
The player died (or left a labyrinth room): tested at $EB8C.
A new background row came in: set by the row builder, cleared by $E659; spawn waits count it.
A draw or flush request: $DD54 calls $D507 when it is set.
